# Customer Portal Requirements

Created: 2026-03-15
Author: Product Team

## Overview
This document captures the MVP features for the customer portal.

## Features
- Allow users to sign in using email and password.
- The system shall lock the account after 5 failed login attempts within 10 minutes.
- Allow users to reset their password via email link.
- Allow users to update their display name.
- Allow users to upload a profile photo in JPG or PNG format up to 2 MB.
- Allow users to search by keyword.
- The system shall sort search results by relevance by default.
- The system shall show a no-results message when no search matches are found.
- Allow users to opt in to email notifications.
- The system shall send a confirmation email when a user changes their email address.

## Notes
- API_KEY values must never be logged.
- Run npm run dev locally when testing the frontend.
